in_marathi.name: Beerendra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Sacred Mountain
in_marathi.long_meaning: Beerendra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Beerendra is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Bhee' meaning 'Lord' and 'Randhra' meaning 'Sacred Mountain'. This name is associated with the Hindu deity Lord Indra, who is known as the god of rain, thunderbolts, and mountains.
